frequency_question: How often do announced tariffs take effect on the scheduled date without being delayed, rescinded, or replaced by a negotiated trade agreement?
membership_rule: Members are major trade restriction announcements by the U.S. executive branch with a specific future implementation date. Excluded are routine administrative tariff adjustments or non-trade sanctions.

cases.name: 2019 Proposed Tariffs on All Mexican Goods

coverage_note: 6 major threatened or implemented tariff episodes examined spanning multiple administrations
known_gaps: Excludes minor sectoral adjustments and subtle tariff rate quotas
skeleton: Total announced major tariff actions vs those implemented on schedule without pre-agreement resolution
validity_reason: Executive trade policy dynamics remain relatively stable across presidential terms, tied to trade negotiation strategies.
